title: Resource response observation
description: Close context written by the BEAR.EventSourcing observation bridge. The body is never inlined: body_ref points at an externalized rendered body and is not extracted into Event::result. A code of 400 or greater marks a failed operation, which is never extracted as an event.

body_ref.description: Storage pointer to the externalized rendered body; stays in the log for inspection only.

durationMs.description: Wall time of the inner invocation in milliseconds, including child operations. Observation data: never part of event identity.
